cpctplus.note: Real nimbleparse runs; wall time includes grammar loading and LR table construction on every invocation; CPCT+ never abstains.

dataset.notes: Synthetic token-level mutations of hand-written programs. Not real student data.

systems.name: Raw parser diagnostics
systems.description: First syntax error reported by the Bison parser; no repair.

systems.name: Panic-mode recovery
systems.description: Bison error productions (sync on ';' and '}'); reports every recovered diagnostic, no repair.

systems.name: Local least-cost repair
systems.description: Same bounded candidate space; ranks by edit cost only, ties by generation order; greedy for later errors; never abstains.

systems.name: IntelliFix w/o AST grouping
systems.description: Margins are computed between individual candidates instead of AST equivalence classes.

systems.name: IntelliFix w/o stability evidence
systems.description: Residual-diagnostic, cascade and completion features removed from the score.

systems.name: IntelliFix w/o abstention
systems.description: Forced top-1: always returns the best plan.

systems.name: IntelliFix w/o layout evidence
systems.description: No layout-informed generators and no line-end / indentation / duplicate evidence.

systems.name: IntelliFix (full)
systems.description: Evidence ranking + AST grouping + hypothesis lanes + abstention.

tau_selection.rule: max coverage s.t. dev selective risk <= 0.1

failure_examples.injected: transpose int i -> i int at 13:8
